messages:
nina: Quick release-train broadcast — soft freeze starts in 60m. Only critical fixes, security hotpatches, and pre-approved rollout items during the window. Please flag exceptions now. :lock:

arjun: A couple things to call out: 1) regional dark-launch for per-request caching in ap-southeast planned at 10% traffic, 2) minor routing tweak to prefer lower-cost variants for background rerank tasks.

pat: Are there any migrations or KMS changes? Need to sync with security infra.

nina: No DB or KMS changes. It's purely serving-layer and routing policy updates. Security hotpatches still allowed with oncall sign-off.

kelly: infra-bot: darklaunch-start ts=1792500300 id=dl-33 region=ap-southeast scope=10% duration=2h. Checks running: [error-rate,latency,p99]. Initial: err=0.2%, p50 ~baseline, p99 +8%.

arjun: Noted p99 bump — expected while caches warm. I'll watch 客户-facing traces.

pat: If p99 stays >12% above baseline at 30m mark, we should trigger rollback. Is that the agreed gate?

nina: Yes. Health gates at t+15m and t+30m. Failure -> auto-rollback command: `ops/release rollback --id dl-33`. Notify #incidents and @oncall.

kelly: infra-bot: health-summary checks=(err<1%, p99<=baseline*1.12, error-traces downtrend). Current: err=0.2%, p99=1.08x, traces stable.

arjun: One more note: this rollout reduces cache TTL for short-lived prefixes. That may increase cache churn briefly; ops alerted.

pat: I'll post a short note to #support if we hit 30% step to let CS know latency profile changed for a subset.

nina: Also: policy reminder — any security exception merged during freeze must include a one-paragraph risk statement and a linked oncall approval in the PR. Execs requested this after last quarter.

arjun: Got it. I'll update the PR template for this train.

kelly: infra-bot: rolling stats at t+20m: error=0.25%, p99=1.05x, cpu=68%. No action required.

pat: Thanks everyone. I'll be available for first hour. If rollback needed, I'll run `./scripts/rollback --id dl-33` and ping #incidents.

nina: Thanks all — I'll send a 1-line exec update at 30m if gates pass. Closing loop.
